person_note: The novel sustains two base narrative modes: a third-person 2019 Manhattan frame centered on adult Maggie and a first-person account in which Maggie narrates her 1995-96 life on Ocracoke. The long third-person quotes (especially q05731 and q05744) agree with the authorized opening, while q05728 and q05737 unmistakably expose sustained first-person scene narration in the past story. Because that oral retrospective constitutes a major continuing section of the novel rather than isolated dialogue or an embedded document, the controlling book-level classification is ALTERNATING. Brief dialogue, aphorisms, direct thoughts, and clipped passages were not promoted to separate narrative modes; no credible second-person strand or unresolved contrary structure was found.
